content.text: SKIP TO CONTENT fourth Add to list ShareCopy link /fɔrθ/ /fɔθ/ IPA guide Other forms: fourths Definitions of fourth noun following the third position; number four in a countable series see moresee less type of: rank relative status noun one of four equal parts synonyms: fourth part, one-fourth, one-quarter, quarter, quartern, twenty-five percent see moresee less type of: common fraction, simple fraction the quotient of two integers adjective coming next after the third and just before the fifth in position or time or degree or magnitude synonyms: 4th, quaternary ordinal being or denoting a numerical order in a series adverb in the fourth place synonyms: fourthly noun the musical interval between one note and another four notes away from it see moresee less type of: interval, musical interval the difference in pitch between two notes Pronunciation US /fɔrθ/ UK /fɔθ/ Cite this entry Style: MLA MLA APA Chicago "Fourth."
